description: Humanoid robotics supply-chain cross-reference and hardware job board. Discover who supplies actuators, harmonic drives, batteries, and compute to leading humanoid platforms.
tagline: The humanoid hardware supply chain, mapped.
image_alt: Institute of Humanoids — supply chain cross-reference for humanoid robotics

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team verifies supply chain relationships and hardware specifications against public teardowns, official partnerships, and direct supplier confirmations.

editorial.testing: Supplier relationships are verified through official press releases, teardown videos from verifiable hardware engineers, and direct confirmation from component manufacturers.
editorial.monetization: We make money through paid job postings for hardware engineering roles and corporate sponsorship from component suppliers. Sponsored listings are explicitly marked.
editorial.corrections: To submit a correction to a supplier relationship or component specification, use the contact form. All corrections require a verifiable primary source.
